$comment: Recall cases for evals/recall.eval.ts. Fictional saved items with the entities Save would link, and selections with the saved items Recall should offer. expect: items that must be offered; ok: items that may also be offered; anything else counts as a false hit. An empty expect means nothing should be offered.

items.text: Jordan Hale shared the venue shortlist for the Q4 offsite: Lisbon, Porto, or Madrid.
Offsite budget: flights capped at $600 per person, hotel at $180 a night.
Maya Chen's notes on the onboarding flow: users drop off at the workspace naming step.
Acme renewal: the contract renews on Jan 1 and the price goes up 8%.
Recipe: one-pan lemon chicken with potatoes, 45 minutes at 200°C.
Weeknight pasta: garlic, chili flakes, olive oil, and parmesan; ready in 15 minutes.
Casey Lin recommended Designing Data-Intensive Applications for the backend reading group.
The launch checklist: press list, landing page copy, screenshots, and the announcement email.
Northwind Traders asked for a demo of the reporting dashboard next quarter.
To fix the flaky test, wait for the database migration to finish before seeding fixtures.
Postgres connection pool exhausted under load; raise max connections or add PgBouncer.
Flight to Lisbon on Oct 21, returning Oct 25; hotel near Alfama.
Hiring plan: two backend engineers and one designer before March.
Jordan Hale prefers calls after 2pm and short agendas sent the day before.
Running plan: three easy runs a week and one long run on Sunday, building up to 10 km.
Q4 revenue forecast: travel spend is 12% over plan, everything else on track.
Maya Chen will present the roadmap at the all-hands on the 24th.
Acme's support team answers within 4 hours on the premium plan.
Interview feedback template: strengths, concerns, and a hire or no-hire call.
Sourdough starter: feed it equal parts flour and water every 12 hours.
